jobs.title: Operations Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FORTUNA HEALTH

We believe accessing healthcare should be as simple as doing your taxes on TurboTax. But for the millions on Medicaid, it’s not.

People lose coverage because of administrative barriers—like missing a notice and incorrect documentation. 60–70% of disenrollments in Medicaid happen for these procedural reasons. These are avoidable errors caused by fragmented systems, not ineligibility.

Fortuna Health is redefining the consumer experience for Medicaid. We’re helping millions navigate Medicaid end-to-end from eligibility and enrollment to renewing coverage. We're backed by a16z, BoxGroup, YC, and top healthcare angels.

We believe this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to dramatically improve the human condition for 90M people, and we need the help of high-throughput, growth-minded builders to make it happen.






ABOUT THE ROLE




WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an early operations hire at Fortuna, you'll play a critical role in shaping how our company scales. We work fully in-person 5 days a week out of our NYC office, and believe deeply in the value of a focused, supportive, and tight-knit team.

As an Ops Lead, you'll independently drive and nurture B2B client relationships while managing the operational engine behind our consumer (B2C) product, owning problems end-to-end for thousands of people navigating coverage every month. This is a fast-paced role with outsized visibility, perfect for someone energized by complexity, execution, and real-world impact.

This is a role that will likely be or grow into being a people manager. We're looking for highly driven generalists who can excel across multiple operational functions, while also being excited to lead and develop a team.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Product Mindset
Our philosophy is that everyone should be product-oriented. We’re fundamentally building a consumer product for the masses. As such, we’re looking for an operations lead who’s motivated by delivering a seamless, user-centered experience. You care more about outcomes than org charts.

Ownership
There's plenty of greenfield, exploratory work to be done. We need someone to be able to take an ambiguous problem and run with it. As we gain traction with specific workflows, we would want you to own that end-to-end.

High Velocity
We are looking for a rockstar operator, someone who is energetic, motivated, and who brings serious focus and passion to everything they do. We need someone who can handle a high-output environment with both speed and detail-orientation.

Respectful Disagreement
We believe it's crucial to be able to openly disagree with anyone on the team. We are looking for someone who doesn't shy away from conflict, but is respectful and empathetic in their approach and always open to different ideas.

Humility
It's important to be able to admit when you're wrong. We are looking for a low-ego teammate who is able to take failures in stride and grow from them.



Requirements

 - 4+ years experience in operations or consulting




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and equity ownership in the company

 - Platinum health insurance plans

 - Free lunch every day

 - All commuter expenses covered

 - $100/month wellness benefit

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k plan with company match

jobs.title: Growth Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FORTUNA HEALTH

Fortuna Health makes modern consumer software for the largest healthcare program in America, serving 80M+ people. We're building navigation technology and AI infrastructure to power the next decade of Medicaid and public healthcare.

Fortuna is backed by a16z, BoxGroup, YC, and advisors / angels including the founders and executives of Abridge, Cityblock, DoorDash, Hex, One Medical, Oscar, Scale AI, Vanta, and ZocDoc. 

We believe this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to dramatically improve the human condition for 80M people, and we need the help of high-throughput, growth-minded builders to make it happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Enterprise Growth Lead at Fortuna, you’ll own landing and expanding across our flagship enterprise accounts - turning signed contracts into deeply embedded, expanding partnerships.

You’ll work directly with senior leadership to take the reins after contract close: building trust with executive champions and driving adoption across our largest clients. You’ll operate as an internal consultant, curious about their problems and bottlenecks, and discover challenges Fortuna can solve, turning that discovery into commercial opportunity.

You’ll also serve as connective tissue between our clients, Operations, and our Product/Engineering teams to directly influence what we build next.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Enterprise Account & Expansion Ownership: Own the commercial health and expansion revenue (ARR/NRR) of key enterprise accounts. Map complex enterprise org charts to introduce new divisions, teams, and high-value use cases to Fortuna. You pitch in as needed to get deals over the finish line.

 - Operational Value Delivery: Partner deeply with customer stakeholders to understand how Fortuna can bring value into their daily workflows, ensure rapid time-to-value, and eliminate adoption friction.

 - Product Strategy & Roadmap Input: Act as the voice of the enterprise customer inside Fortuna. Translate their needs and pain points into clear feedback to directly shape our product roadmap.

 - Executive Partnership: Build deep relationships with C-suite/VP champions and business leads. Conduct regular meetings, track business impact metrics, and position Fortuna as a core strategic partner. Support ad hoc asks to always demonstrate Fortuna as dedicated partner.

 - Playbook & Systems Building: Establish the early playbooks, customer frameworks, and expansion motions that will scale our enterprise operations function as we grow.
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience: 4+ years of professional experience, featuring a mix of strategy consulting, investment banking, operations, or growth/GTM at a high-growth startup.

 - Systems & Product Instincts: Highly analytical with strong business acumen. You understand complex data/workflow architectures and know how to bridge technical solutions with business outcomes.

 - Commercial Mindset: Comfortable owning revenue, driving account expansion, and navigating commercial discussions with enterprise buyers.

 - Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication. You can lead a meeting with executive stakeholders comfortably and be dangerous enough on the details.

 - Builder Mentality: High agency, low ego, and comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments where playbooks are built as you execute.
   
   


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Competitive salary and equity ownership in the company

 - Platinum health insurance plans

 - Free lunch every day

 - All commuter expenses covered

 - $100/month wellness benefit

 - Unlimited PTO

 - 401k plan with company match
